name: TeamSpeak6
description: TeamSpeak 6 Server (Beta) - next generation voice server. Data lives in /var/tsserver. BETA NOTICE: This is a beta release. The server ships with a 32-slot beta license that is renewed every two months; larger licenses are not available for TS6 yet. MIGRATION: There is no migration path from TeamSpeak 3 - existing ts3server.sqlitedb files cannot be imported. CLIENTS: TeamSpeak 3 clients (3.6.0+) can connect to a TS6 server.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Server data (SQLite database, files, logs, license).

ports.name: Voice
ports.description: Main voice port for client connections.

ports.name: File Transfer
ports.description: File transfer port for icons, avatars and channel files.

ports.name: WebQuery
ports.description: HTTP query interface for automation and tooling.

variables.name: License agreement
variables.description: Set to 'accept' (or '1') to confirm you agree to the TeamSpeak license. The server will not start without it.

variables.name: Log timezone
variables.description: Timezone for log timestamps. Valid values are 'utc' and 'local' only - arbitrary zones like Europe/Vienna are rejected.

variables.name: Container timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, used when log timezone is set to 'local'. Ignored if the image lacks tzdata.
